scenes.title: Alternating bass
scenes.subtitle: The Travis-picking foundation.
lines: This lesson teaches the Travis-picking foundation: alternating bass notes with your thumb, while your fingers play melody and rhythm on the higher strings.

scenes.heading: Alternating bass
lines: Let's try Travis-style picking: your thumb alternates between two bass strings on every beat, while your fingers add notes in between.
For a C chord, use thumb on string 5 and string 4; for G, thumb on string 6 and string 4.
Keep it steady and let the rhythm flow naturally — you're doing great!

scenes.title: C with alternating bass
lines: Let's practice alternating bass on C.
Thumb on string 5, index on 3, thumb on 4, middle on 2.

scenes.title: G with alternating bass
lines: Let's practice alternating bass with the G chord.
Play these notes in order: thumb on string 6, index on 3, thumb on 4, middle on 2.
Let your thumb move freely between the 5th and 4th strings.
Play along — the app is listening, ready to help you grow.
